text:
sam: quick sync — PR #18912 (https://git/repo/pull/18912) is green on unit & smoke but integration matrix shows 2 failures in `integration/sql-smoke` that look transient. CI has been retrying for 45m and it's blocking our rebase window. Can we propose swapping our rebase slot from 22:00 UTC to 01:15 UTC to avoid the org deploy blackout at 00:00?

ci-bot: [ci] PR #18912 - integration/sql-smoke failed on runner-7. Retry #3 queued.

mia: pinging @olivia @alex — how critical is DB blackout at 00:00? We might be able to shift to 01:00 if 01:15 is bad.

olivia: DB migration starts at 23:45 UTC and runs ~30m, so 01:15 is fine from infra side. Prefer not to be in peak APAC hours though.

sam: thanks. failing log (excerpt): ```ERROR: Timeout waiting for replica sync
at replication.go:212
--- FAIL: TestSQLReplicaLag  (0.00s)``` seems flaky.

raj: I can rerun the integration shard at 01:10 UTC from APAC pool (lower queue). That would warm caches and hopefully make canary pass.

mia: also request a manual canary deploy after merge to dedicated staging-only. @alex can you approve the slot move? We need release-owner signoff.

alex: approved. Move rebase to 01:15 UTC, rerun at 01:10, canary deploy to staging post-merge. :thumbsup: 

sam: thanks all — scheduling rerun now. ci-bot, please prioritize rerun on apac-pool.

ci-bot: [ci] Manual rerun started: integration/sql-smoke on apac-pool (triggered by sam).

deploy-bot: Rebase slot updated: PR #18912 -> 2025-03-08 01:15:00 UTC. Canary plan attached.

olivia: noted. Leaving a brief hold on auto-rollout until we confirm canary smoke passes.

sam: will post results here. If all green we'll land and tag the canary. Thx!
